name: Deepgram Voice Agent API
tagline: The speech-infrastructure company's own voice-agent API — managed STT+LLM+TTS with a 6-provider LLM router, deployable fully managed, VPC-hosted, or fully self-hosted.
verdict: Deepgram Voice Agent API sits between the raw OpenAI Realtime API and a fully-configured platform like Bland AI or Retell AI: a managed STT+LLM+TTS orchestration layer from the company several rival platforms already plug in as a speech-to-text provider (LiveKit Agents names Deepgram directly in its own provider list). The genuinely distinguishing fact is deployment — fully managed, dedicated single-tenant, VPC-hosted, or fully self-hosted are all real options, backed by SOC 2 Type II certification and signed HIPAA BAAs, a spread no other closed-source vendor in this category matches. Its built-in LLM router is also the broadest here: six named providers spanning 30+ models, including open-weight options via Groq and NVIDIA, versus a fixed model or a narrower bring-your-own list everywhere else. The tradeoffs: no ongoing free tier (a one-time $200 credit only), no dashboard or CRM integrations — it's infrastructure a developer builds on top of, not a configured product — and the cheapest published rate only applies once you've brought your own LLM and TTS.
